citation: Amaral, Fantinato, and Peres (2018), UCI Machine Learning Repository, DOI 10.24432/C57S4H

candidate_task.decision_event: second strictly later update before resolution or closure
candidate_task.positive: closed_at is strictly after decision time and within seven days
candidate_task.negative: closed_at is later than seven days after decision time
candidate_task.censored: missing or invalid close timestamp, closure at or before decision, or insufficient prior events
